scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind recognising information sources.
Interview: collects answers by talking to people. Photograph: records a visual moment.
Newspaper: reports news and events. Questionnaire: collects written responses. Recording: stores captured sound or video.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Interview, Photograph and Newspaper; explain what each means.
